cond_0001.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. The incumbent will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Assist in the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience in a chemistry lab
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value creating outcomes that are useful, fair, and mindful of the people they affect. We aim to approach our work with responsibility and respect.

The incumbent will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0012.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Assist in the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0012.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Around 6 months to 2 years of experience in a testing laboratory, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; background in a chemistry lab is a plus
cond_0012.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0035.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. You will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to deliver analytical information that supports the manufacturing process and ensures product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0035.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Execute routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Manage labeling of non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Lead special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Drive technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; deliver analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Take ownership of the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and drive resolution
Ensure disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0035.requirements:
Bachelor's degree preferred in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent with experience in a chemistry lab preferred

cond_0046.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. The incumbent will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0046.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Assist in the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0046.requirements:
Bachelor's degree preferred in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent with experience in a chemistry lab preferred

cond_0057.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. The incumbent will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0057.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Assist in the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0057.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around 6 months to 2 years of experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Background in a chemistry lab setting

You will take ownership of testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to deliver analytical information that supports the manufacturing process and ensures product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0080.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Execute routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Direct labeling of non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Lead contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Drive special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials
Own the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; deliver analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Take ownership of the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement; carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensure disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guidelines
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0080.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent with experience in a chemistry lab
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience
cond_0080.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0129.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. The incumbent will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0129.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Assist in the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others

Minimum Requirements
Around 6 months to 2 years of experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Background in a chemistry lab setting

cond_0251.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. You will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to deliver analytical information that supports the manufacturing process and ensures product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0251.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Execute routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Manage labeling of non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Lead special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Drive technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; deliver analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Take ownership of the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and drive resolution
Ensure disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0251.requirements:
Bachelor's degree preferred in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent with experience in a chemistry lab preferred

cond_0296.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. You will take ownership of testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to deliver analytical information that supports the manufacturing process and ensures product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0296.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Execute routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Direct labeling of non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Lead contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Drive special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials
Own the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; deliver analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Take ownership of the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement; carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensure disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guidelines
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0296.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent with experience in a chemistry lab
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience

cond_0357.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. You will regularly perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab, communicating analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0357.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and actively communicate and present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials
Share technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees on an ongoing basis
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety and health of self and other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by actively participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensure disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guidelines
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0357.requirements:
Bachelor's degree preferred in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent with experience in a chemistry lab preferred

cond_0369.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. cond_0369.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Help label non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and share test results and pertinent information with appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Work with colleagues on special testing and analysis in support of new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples, and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials
Support the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; share analytical feedback with production employees
Help ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted, and done so in a timely manner
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and sharing constructive feedback for safety improvement; coordinate safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and help work toward resolution
Ensure disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guidelines
Participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant
Communication
Proactively share issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others

Minimum Requirements
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience in a chemistry lab

The incumbent will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with lab testing and analytical work.
cond_0419.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Assist in the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0419.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience in a chemistry lab

Technical/Functional

Quality

Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.

Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement

Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others

cond_0480.intro: This role will be part of a dynamic team supporting production of a high quality product. The incumbent will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0480.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Assist in the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
cond_0480.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Around 6 months to 2 years of experience in a testing laboratory, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; background in a chemistry lab is a plus

cond_0543.intro: This role will be part of a team supporting production of a high quality product. The incumbent will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0543.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional
Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on analytical equipment
Prepare and qualify reagents as required
Assist in labeling non-conforming material as needed
Analyze and report results via SAP and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons
Conduct contamination testing using Mass Spectrometry
Prepare samples for shipment following regulatory requirements
Conduct special testing and analysis in conjunction with new product development, trouble-shooting of complaint samples and investigation/analysis of off-spec products and raw materials.
Assist in the technical expertise and knowledge of analytical chemistry; provide analytical feedback to production employees
Ensure samples in the control laboratory are processed fully, accurately, posted and done so in a timely manner.
Quality
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods
Comply with ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant
Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system
Safety/Health/Environment
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals
Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities
Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution
Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is within compliance for regulatory and plant guideline
Lead and participate in safety audits pertaining to the laboratory and plant.
Communication
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement
Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner
Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner
Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others
